metadata.description: Benchmark evaluation questions for testing hybrid retrieval, RRF, CrossEncoder reranking, and citation accuracy.

questions.question: What dense embedding model and vector dimension does Knovex AI use for hybrid retrieval?
questions.ground_truth_context: Uses sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 yielding 384-dimensional dense vectors with cosine similarity distance.

questions.question: How is tenant isolation enforced within the Qdrant vector database?
questions.ground_truth_context: In Qdrant, points are stored with a tenant_id keyword payload. Every query applies a strict filter { key: 'metadata.tenant_id', match: { value: tenant_id } }.

questions.question: Which CrossEncoder model is used for reranking and how many top candidates are selected?
questions.ground_truth_context: Model: cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 running locally. Top-K Selection: Filters the top 5 highest-confidence passages for prompt synthesis.

questions.question: What is the token expiration lifespan and rate limit defined in the security policy?
questions.ground_truth_context: Access tokens expire after 60 minutes. Refresh tokens expire after 7 days. Rate Limiting: maximum rate of 60 requests per minute per authenticated user identifier.

questions.question: What are the allowed file types and maximum upload file size?
questions.ground_truth_context: Allowed File Types: Ingestion is strictly limited to Portable Document Format (.pdf) and plain text (.txt, .md). The maximum permissible upload size is 15 Megabytes.

questions.question: What happens when a document is deleted under the data retention policy?
questions.ground_truth_context: Upon user request or document deletion, records are purged from the PostgreSQL document_chunks table and corresponding vector points are permanently removed from the Qdrant vector database via filter selector.
